greet.speaker: Sporewell Broodmother
greet.text: The flooded chamber's stillness breaks as something enormous rises from beneath the black water, trailing pale fungal threads.
greet.text_zh: 積水大廳原本靜止不動，此刻卻被某個從黑水下方升起的龐然巨物打破——身後拖曳著蒼白的菌絲。

battle_start.speaker: Sporewell Broodmother
battle_start.text: Tendrils lash out across the flooded stone.
battle_start.text_zh: 觸鬚在積水的石地上猛然揮動而出。

already_won.text: The water has finally gone clear. Whatever grew here is gone.
already_won.text_zh: 積水終於變得清澈。曾在此處滋長的東西已經消失無蹤。
